title: A Note on the Norm of the Embedding of $\text{PW}^2$ into $\text{PW}^q$
summary: We improve the currently best known bound for the norm of the embedding of $PW^2$ into $PW^q$ for all $q>2$. We show that our bound is asymptotically optimal as $q\to \infty$. Our approach combines the recently established theorem of optimal Paley-Wiener concentration with a Hardy-Littlewood-Pólya majorization argument.
